I replied to Ilse in her thread in #north-random to confirm that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 10 June. I didn't change anything, since she said no action was needed.

I also suggested she fix her post in #north-team, because her earlier date is still there and people may go by it. I didn't save a note of the correction: notes only show up in the channel where they're saved, so one here wouldn't help anyone in #north-team.
